    Research

    Research experience

    Toyama 2023 – present
    Cairo 2022 – 2023

    2023 – present

    Systems Neuroscience

    Inokuchi Laboratory · University of Toyama, Japan

    Memory integration, transitive inference and offline prefrontal processing

    • Developed a new head-fixed olfactory paradigm for transitive inference, in which mice learn overlapping odor pairs and are then tested on novel relational choices (first-author manuscript submitted to Molecular Brain).
    • Used post-session chemogenetic inhibition of the medial prefrontal cortex and sleep deprivation to test how offline processing after learning contributes to subsequent inference.
    • Recorded prefrontal populations with Neuropixels 2.0 during behavior and subsequent sleep, and analyzed task-related representations across learning and inference.
    2022 – 2023

    Neuropharmacology

    Faculty of Pharmacy · Cairo University, Egypt

    Natural coumarins in mouse models of schizophrenia-like behavior, mood and cognition

    • Investigated natural compounds in preclinical mouse models of cognition and of depression-, anxiety- and schizophrenia-related behavior.
    • Collaboration with the Medical University of Lublin, Poland; published in European Journal of Pharmacology (2025, co-first author) and Acta Poloniae Pharmaceutica – Drug Research (2025, first author).
